purpose: MAX NET SHARPE, drawdown unconstrained (instruction 2026-09-04: stop designing around prop-firm limits). Gold-overweight core-4 book on the swap-free instrument: net Sharpe +1.212 vs +1.096 equal weight and +1.065 gold alone, all measured net of Maven's live carry.
_vol_note: The dial is the only knob — Sharpe is leverage-invariant (xau-riskfrac-sizing-table), so it scales CAGR and DD together. Measured on this book: 20% dial -> CAGR +24.9% / maxDD -26.1%; 40% -> +49.8% / -46.1%. 20% is a placeholder, not a finding. Set it to the loss you are actually willing to take.
_dd_warning: THESE DRAWDOWNS BREACH A 10% MAX-LOSS ACCOUNT BY CONSTRUCTION, and backtest DD is close-to-close so real intraday excursions are worse. This config needs an account with no such wall — own capital, the HFM cent account, or a funded account with looser terms. On the Maven challenge use configs/v5_maven_book.json instead.
_weights_note: Gold 50%, the other three 16.7% each. Justified because gold's net-Sharpe advantage comes largely from a CONTRACTUAL fact (zero carry on GoldEternal vs -3.96% to -30%/yr on the others), not from an estimated alpha. It is a PLATEAU, not a knife edge — 40% gold gives +1.200, 50% +1.212, 60% +1.196, 70% +1.167 — so the exact number does not matter much; anywhere in 40-60% is the same answer. Requires the `class_weights` support added to v5_basket_challenge.py on 2026-09-04 (default path regression-checked byte-identical).

_statistical_honesty: The tilt's paired-t at matched vol is +0.93 vs gold alone (4/9 years) and +0.75 vs equal weight (5/9). Both are BELOW the +1.50 bar used everywhere else in this repo, so this is 'real but unproven', not established. What supports it beyond the t-stat is that the driver is deterministic carry and the response is a flat plateau rather than a spike.
